title: Molly's Beach Haven
meta_description: Experience comfort and convenience at this charming 2-bedroom condo in the heart of WaterColor. Located just across from Cerulean Park and steps from the Beach Club, this beautifully appointed retreat offers access to all the community’s premier amenities
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- 2 beach cruiser bikes included- Beach Towels Included- Apple TV- Sonos soundbar and sub- Formal dining area with seating for 6- En suite master bathroom with dual vanities- Wrap-around screened-in porchStep into coastal luxury at this stunning two-bedroom, two-bathroom penthouse condo nestled in the vibrant heart of the WaterColor community along scenic 30A. Perfectly designed for relaxation and beachside living, this top-floor retreat boasts a spacious wrap-around screened-in porch—ideal for sipping morning coffee or unwinding with sunset views over the charming town below.Inside, you’ll find serene coastal-inspired décor that evokes a sense of calm and sophistication. The open-concept living area is bathed in natural light and flows seamlessly into a fully equipped kitchen, making entertaining effortless. In addition to the two beautifully appointed bedrooms and spa-like bathrooms, a bonus bunk area adds flexible sleeping arrangements for families or groups—comfortably accommodating up to six guests.Located just a short stroll from the white-sand beaches and the exclusive WaterColor Beach Club—complete with oceanfront dining and resort-style pools—you’re also minutes away from the iconic Seaside community, known for its picturesque streets, boutique shops, and yummy eateries.Elevator access ensures ease for every guest, while the top-floor location guarantees peaceful privacy. Whether you're planning a family vacation, a romantic escape, or a friends’ getaway, this luxurious WaterColor condo is your home base for an unforgettable 30A experience.Watercolor Community Highlights:- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickleball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesTDT-221824
